Name: Shop Tweaks - Minor Tweaks to Vanilla Shops
Author: Exonika
Description:
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/YqMFNV9L/Bannner-Main.png[/img]
​
This mod adds additional items to multiple vanilla game shops that you'd expect them to sell, ranging from battery packs to ores. 
​​
​
​
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/jqww5JgN/features.png[/img]

[b]Multiple shops with new stock![/b]

The Carpenter Shop:[spoiler]
[list]
[*]Hardwood:       50g, Year 1 - 100g, Year 2+
[*]Clay:                  70g, Year 1 - 120g, Year 2+ 
[*]Battery Pack:   600g, Year 1 - 700g, Year 2+[/spoiler]
[/list]
The Oasis Shop:[spoiler]
[list]
[*]Coffee Bean:                     100g, Year 1 - 150g, Year 2+
[*]Carrot Seeds:                    50g, Year 1 - 100g, Year 2+ (Spring-Only)
[*]Summer Squash Seeds:   75g, Year 1 - 125g, Year 2+ (Summer-Only) 
[*]Broccoli Seeds:                 100g, Year 1 - 150g, Year 2+ (Fall-Only)
[*]Powdermelon Seeds:       75g, Year 1 - 125g, Year 2+ (Winter-Only)[/spoiler]
[/list]
The Fish Shop:[spoiler]
[list]
[*]Crab:            150g, Year 1 - 200g, Year 2+
[*]Crayfish:      125g, Year 1 - 175g, Year 2+
[*]Lobster:       170g, Year 1 - 220g, Year 2+
[*]Periwinkle:   70g, Year 1 - 120g, Year 2+
[*]Shrimp:        110g, Year 1 - 160g, Year 2+
[*]Snail:            115g, Year 1 - 165g, Year 2+
[*]Sea Jelly:     250g, Year 1 - 300g, Year 2+
[*]Cave Jelly:   230g, Year 1 - 280g, Year 2+
[*]River Jelly:   175, Year 1 - 225g, Year 2+[/spoiler]
[/list]
The Dwarf Shop:[spoiler]
[list]
[*]Explosive Ammo:   70g, Year 1 - 120g, Year 2
[*]Immunity Band:     100,000g, All-Year[/spoiler]
[/list]
The Blacksmith Shop:[spoiler]
[list]
[*]Iridium Ore:           600g, Year 1 - 800g, Year 2+ (Has Found Iridium Ore Atleast Once)
[*]Radioactive Ore:   800g, Year 1 - 1100g, Year 2+ ("Completed "Danger in the Deep" Quest)[/spoiler]
[/list]
The General Store:[spoiler]
[list]
[*]Strawberry Seeds:       150g, Year 1 - 200g, Year 2+ (Spring-Only)
[*]Tea Sapling:                 300g, Year 1 - 350g, Year 2+ (Has Learnt Recipe) [/spoiler]
[/list]
The Ranch:[spoiler]
[list]
[*]Fiber:       20g, Year 1 - 40g, Year 2+ [/spoiler]
[/list]​

‍
[*][b]Unzip the compressed file[/b]
‍‍

      v1.0.0: Initial Release.
      
      v1.0.5: Minor Update and Additions.

      v1.0.6: Initial Stardew Valley 1.6.9 Update, Additions, Year-Based Updates.

      v1.0.7: Minor Additions, Minor Bug Fixed, Multiplayer Compatibility confirmed. 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/7hny6Vpw/compatibility.png[/img]

Multiplayer Compataible: [b]Yes, see under spoiler.[/b] ﻿[spoiler]
The Iridium Ore is only purchase-able by the player who's found Iridium Ore before; example, if Player A has found Iridium Ore and Player B hasn't that means [b]only[/b] Player A will see Iridium Ore in the Blacksmith's Shop.﻿[/spoiler]﻿
